paths.description: Public portal entry page, representing search, service navigation, news feed, ads, consent and sign-in entry points.
News listing archetype selected from primary navigation, representing dense editorial indexes.
Representative news article/detail page selected from the homepage lead story.
Primary sign-in journey reached from the homepage, representing the account form and authentication choices.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference leaves a long-running animation active.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion evaluate probe reported a running .dtd-b-banner__image animation with a 7000 ms duration while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential animation in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and provide a static reduced-motion state.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility found the primary sign-in control at 4.13:1 and error-state text as low as 1.03:1; accessibility score was 0.73.
findings.suggestedFix: Use tested foreground/background tokens meeting WCAG AA in every theme and error state.

findings.summary: State changes do not use declarative transitions.
findings.evidence: Recon found browser support but no page-level View Transition usage; the portal swaps menus/content abruptly and the DOM/CSS evidence contained no view-transition rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance meaningful same-document state and route changes with View Transitions, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Overlapping consent and location overlays obscure the primary content.
findings.evidence: The desktop screenshot shows a large consent panel covering the news feed while a separate geolocation panel sits beneath it; the consent UI advertises 675 third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one semantic dialog for required consent, delay optional location prompting until user intent, restore focus, and avoid stacked overlays.

findings.summary: Ads and application chrome dominate the entry page.
findings.evidence: The first viewport devotes a large left column and a lead banner to ads, while consent and location chrome obscure the news content and primary service choices compete for attention.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise Mail/search/news content, reserve secondary promotions for later, and reduce simultaneous banners and framed chrome.

findings.summary: Mobile scaling is restricted and the portal is rendered as a compressed desktop canvas.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two viewport tags with user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1; the 360x800 capture presents tiny desktop-density content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a single width=device-width viewport without scaling restrictions and redesign dense regions with fluid intrinsic layout.

findings.summary: Reusable portal components do not demonstrate container-level adaptation.
findings.evidence: The recon probe counted zero container rules, while cards and navigation are reused across narrow and wide columns and rely on page-level scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable regions and use @container rules for card, nav, and widget composition changes.

findings.summary: Keyboard and document structure are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The homepage has no headings, 43 textless anchors, and many navigation links/buttons compute outline:none; Lighthouse also found an unnamed account button.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical h1/h2 structure, accessible names, and a clearly visible :focus-visible treatment for every interactive control.

findings.summary: The portal is slow to paint and settle.
findings.evidence: Trace measured FCP 3.48 s and LCP 5.17 s; Lighthouse measured LCP 5.09 s, CLS 0.151, Speed Index 9.2 s and TTI 21.1 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, shorten document latency, reserve dynamic space, and defer below-fold/third-party work.

findings.summary: The entry load is dominated by scripts and third parties.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 317 requests and 7.51 MB transferred, including 52 scripts/3.48 MB and 296 third-party requests/7.35 MB; Lighthouse estimated 786 KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Load only task-critical code initially, split/defer feed and advertising bundles, and gate third parties on consent and visibility.

findings.summary: Interactive and media content lacks accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found unnamed buttons, untitled frames and images without alt; the image primitive reported 19 images missing alt and the probe found 43 textless anchors.
findings.suggestedFix: Give controls programmatic names, title frames, and provide meaningful alt or explicit decorative treatment.

findings.summary: The page prevents user zoom.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identified user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1 on two viewport meta elements, blocking magnification.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale restrictions, keep one viewport declaration, then verify reflow at 200% and 400%.

findings.summary: Runtime and platform errors occur during a normal load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found CORS failures, CSP violations and console errors; HAR also recorded failed/aborted requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or correctly configure failing integrations and treat production console/network errors as release blockers.

findings.summary: Deprecated unload handling blocks modern navigation caching.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a deprecated unload listener and six BFCache failure reasons, including the main-frame unload handler.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload work with pagehide/visibilitychange where needed and remove avoidable BFCache blockers.

findings.summary: Many images lack dimensions or efficient delivery attributes.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 17 images without width/height, 11 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 20 legacy-format images and one oversized image.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions/aspect-ratio, lazy-load below-fold content, and serve responsive modern formats.

findings.summary: The public portal is largely absent without JavaScript and is blocked by robots policy.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 1% raw/rendered content overlap and identified a JS shell; Lighthouse reports indexing blocked by mail.ru/robots.txt line 7.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the portal’s core links and content, and align robots policy with intended public indexing.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS/CSP/nosniff/frame protection, but no HSTS, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy and CSP permits unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline; 7 cookies are not Secure and most use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS and restrictive browser policies, remove unsafe CSP allowances where possible, and set Secure/SameSite/HttpOnly attributes by cookie purpose.

findings.summary: The default page has an excessive tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: The consent UI lists 675 third parties; network evidence observed 27 third-party origins, 296 third-party requests and 7.35 MB third-party transfer, including analytics and ad systems before consent was given.
findings.suggestedFix: Default to data minimisation, block non-essential vendors until opt-in, reduce the vendor list, and batch essential telemetry.

findings.summary: Authentication lacks passkey-first and autofill-friendly input.
findings.evidence: The sign-in page exposes password/social-style choices but no passkey action; its username field uses autocomplete=off, has no associated label, and page html lang is empty.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer a passkey/WebAuthn sign-in path and use a labelled username field with autocomplete=username and appropriate input semantics.

findings.summary: Core portal content depends on JavaScript.
findings.evidence: The raw HTML retained title/description but only 1% of rendered content words, while the no-JS crawler screenshot shows skeletons rather than usable news and navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core content and links, then hydrate enhancements without replacing accessible baseline content.

findings.summary: The redirected sign-in page omits document language.
findings.evidence: Homepage html lang is ru, but the representative sign-in page renders English text with an empty html lang attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct lang on every localized document and update it when locale changes; verify bidi and logical-property behavior.

findings.summary: The login field is not wired for accessible validation or autofill.
findings.evidence: An invalid-input probe found no aria-invalid or alert messaging; the text field has no label and autocomplete=off.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a labelled form control, autocomplete=username, delayed constraint validation, aria-invalid, and an announced actionable error message.

findings.summary: Resource use is disproportionate to a portal entry page.
findings.evidence: The HAR transferred 7.51 MB with 296 third-party requests; scripts consumed 3.48 MB, images 1.72 MB, and third parties 7.35 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set page-weight and third-party budgets, defer feeds/media/ads until visible and consented, and remove low-value vendors and legacy assets.

findings.summary: The initial memory footprint is unusually large.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap contained 1,820,979 nodes and 99.6 MB self size for the portal; repeated menu interaction did not increase it, but the steady-state footprint remains high.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the largest bundles/constructors, avoid mounting offscreen feeds and ad systems eagerly, and enforce a steady-state memory budget.

findings.summary: Late content causes visible layout movement.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.151 and found 15 layout shifts; 17 images lack explicit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image/ad/widget space and use stable font fallbacks so late resources cannot move existing content.

taskList.title: Cut third-party and advertising work before consent and visibility
Restore accessible zoom, names, focus and contrast
Server-render the public portal core and align robots policy
Replace stacked consent/location interruptions with one semantic flow
Improve LCP/CLS by reserving space and deferring non-critical bundles
Harden headers, CSP and cookie attributes
Add passkey-first, labelled and autofill-friendly sign-in
Remove runtime errors, unload handlers and BFCache blockers
Respect reduced motion and add progressive declarative transitions
Adopt fluid and container-responsive component layouts
